response.sql: WITH site_ratio AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS zone, s.insurstat AS insurstat, AVG(m.facetresmm * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS mesh_count FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.insurstat) <> '' GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat HAVING AVG(m.facetresmm * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) IS NOT NULL), status_avg AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM site_ratio GROUP BY insurstat) SELECT r.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(r.ratio) AS above_avg_sites_avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS above_avg_site_count, AVG(r.ratio - a.avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_over_status_avg FROM site_ratio r JOIN status_avg a ON a.insurstat = r.insurstat WHERE r.ratio > a.avg_ratio GROUP BY r.insurstat
